description:
Approx. 2 km of downhill singletrack bike trails with the option of tying into the lower portion of the Packhorse Trail or exiting onto Old Lakelse Lake Road.

Managed under Agreement with the Terrace Off Road Cycling Association
directions: From the 4 way stop junction of Highway 16 E. and Highway 37, drive 1/2 km. east on Highway 16. Drive 6 km. along Old Lakelse Lake Road. 800 m. past the Thornhill Landfill turn left onto the Copper Mountain road. Follow the Copper Mountain road for approx. 4 km. to the trailhead. The road continues up to communications towers on Thornhill Mountain.
